description: This source file defines the 'RomRaiderWrapper' class, which serves as an entry point and utility wrapper for starting and initializing RomRaider ECU editing environment within the project. It includes a main method to launch RomRaider with a specific configuration and methods to initialize the environment.

classes.name: RomRaiderWrapper
